posts.meta_description:
12K likes, 572 comments - mattogus on July 21, 2024: "🙏🏼AND NEW - WNBF PRO NATURAL BODYBUILDER 🙏🏼⁣
-⁣
Only Took me 13 years since my first try here in 2011, but the journey (my family being my everything, first and foremost) and earning this here at this specific show, where not just anyone can walk in and win, are worth so much more to me than simply being able to call myself a pro. If everyone (especially those not in this sport) views “it” the same, then I honestly don’t want it lol. This may be hard to understand outside the sport - and this post isn’t about judgement or to boast, but to express the overarching concept of journey over destination - that may be one of the few things (besides my wife) that I’ve done right in my life, at least in my opinion.. ⁣
-⁣
The world sees [natural] pro bodybuilder but within this niche sport, the honor-bound understand the levels and know the nuance. Of individual talent, placing, showing, and context of pro card win. Thats kinda how I’ve always seen it. There’s natural pros (so many organizations)… then there’s WNBF pros… (including pros who won at super pro qualifiers - multiple cards given - again, a potential but not necessarily automatic asterisk in my book that I never particularly wanted for myself, since i hold that asterisk silently, without judgement, for others). and then there’s Muscle Mayhem Champion pro card winners - generally no asterisks. You’re a pro natural bodybuilder in my book. End of story.⁣
-⁣
At this point in my life, I wouldn’t put NATURAL PRO in my profile if I didn’t win this HERE. I don’t think my journey would be done MY WAY if I didn’t earn this here (eg I went and earned it at a less competitive show) ⁣
-⁣
There’s levels to this and those who know, know. And Those who don’t, don’t. There’s levels above me that I can’t even compete with yet. Not for years. And that’s just a part of reality, but also how I enjoy my journey. MY journey. Yours should be done YOUR way!
-⁣
Just another day but one that reminds me that life is to be lived in the moments between the peaks - the journey is more important than the destination. Do your journey YOUR way. As you have read above, I have certainly done it my way 🫶⁣
-⁣
@wnbfofficial @musclemayhem_inbf".

posts.meta_description:
357 likes, 29 comments - mattogus on October 18, 2026: "Comment "TRAIN1" for my exact program

The 3 heads of the triceps perform elbow extension. 

The long head is interesting because it crosses both the shoulder and elbow joints, and performs shoulder extension.

So, you feel the long head a lot during all kinds of pullover variations and rolling skullcrushers and tricep kickbacks... and you won't feel it at all when doing presses (where the elbow extends WHILE the shoulder extends - goes up)

This cable pullover variation is not a bread and butter movement for me, but it's something fun I'm throwing into my training groups, especially during tricep specialization phases.

Tricep (or arms) specialization phases can make sense for the discerning lifter, placed here and there.

For example, someone taking a step back on their pressing volumes/exercises for shoulder reasons. When you do that, you're also bringing down your tricep volume since the triceps (lateral and medial heads) are heavily involved in pressing. 

Triceps training for *some* gains, for most people, can be as simple as just performing 1-3 sets of pushdowns and/or overhead extensions or skullcrushers, close to failure, 1-3 times per week.

For those playing the long game of max long term muscle accumulation, it can end up quite a bit more nuanced than that. 

Navigating through, and ideally, navigating AROUND what would have been periods of gains-limiting joint pain.

And that's why I think it pays to surround yourself with or be coached by people still building muscle 10, 15, 20 productive years in the game and/or those who help others achieve that.

Comment TRAIN1 to forthwith start training with me.".
